Initial release of ISO 42001 AIMS Readiness Assessment.

- Provides automated evaluation of organizational readiness for ISO/IEC 42001:2023 AI Management Systems.
- Delivers an overall readiness score, clause-by-clause gap analysis, and a prioritized remediation roadmap.
- Supports use cases like AI governance maturity, EU AI Act preparation, responsible AI, and ISO 42001 certification readiness.
- Requires TOOLWEB_API_KEY and curl.
- Presents results in a clear, structured format and guides user interaction with required/optional details.
